main_text.p: אספלידא Ch. Spelunca, Exod.33.22. in Jon. Corrupta vox, ex Græc. σπηλαιον, vel σπηλάδιον.
אספלעיתא, אספלניתא Ch. Splenium, σπληνιον, Emplastrum, Jobi 30.24.
[illegible, ~6 letters] Syr. Aspis, ἀσπις, serpentum species, ad Roman.3.13.
אספקלטור Ch. [illegible, ~8 letters] Syr. Speculator, satelles, carnifex, Mar.6.27. Reperitur & absque א.
אספקלר, אספקלריא, אספקלר Ch. Speculare, speculum. Plur. אספקלרין Specula, Deut.33.17. in Jon.
אספרנא, אספור, [illegible, ~5 letters] Vide in ספר.
[illegible, ~5 letters] Syr. Σπυρίς, Sporta. Plur. [illegible, ~5 letters].
אספרמקין Ch. Aromata, Pharmaca. A Græco φάρμακον, Deut.28.23. in Targ. Jonath.
אסק איסקריטין Ch. Tubi, Fistulæ, Zach.4.12. Item Lagana, Placentæ, Exod.16.31. in Onkelo.
אסר [illegible, ~3 letters] Ch. & Syr. Ligavit, colligavit, vincivit, vinxit: Item Ch. Prohibere, vetare. Aphel אסר Idem. Ithpeh, Chald. אתאסר, Syr. [illegible, ~4 letters] Ligari, Vinciri.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic/Syriac and Greek words are rendered approximately where the scan is too small to read letter by letter; the Syriac and Hebrew forms in the scan are partly illegible and marked accordingly. Printed Aramaic script forms in the entries "Speculator", "Aspis", "Splenium" and "Sporta" could not be fully verified.
